name: BVA_Lightning_Page_Views_and_Interactions
label: BVA Lightning Page Views and Interactions

fields.name: PageName
fields.label: PageName
fields.formulaExpression:
case
	when (contains(PAGE_URL, '/lightning/n/') AND instr(PAGE_URL,'?') > 0) then substr(PAGE_URL,14,instr(PAGE_URL,'?')-14)
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/n/') AND instr(PAGE_URL,'?') = 0) then substr(PAGE_URL,14)
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/cmp/') AND instr(PAGE_URL,'?') > 0) then substr(PAGE_URL,16,instr(PAGE_URL,'?')-16)
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/cmp/') AND instr(PAGE_URL,'?') = 0) then substr(PAGE_URL,16)
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/s/') AND PAGE_ENTITY_TYPE = '') then substr(PAGE_URL,2,instr(PAGE_URL,'/s/')-2)
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/page/pardot')) then 'Pardot'
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/page/chatter')) then 'Chatter'
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/page/home')) then 'Home'
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/settings')) then 'Personal Settings'
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/setup')) then 'Setup'
	when (contains(PAGE_URL,'/one/one.app')) AND PAGE_ENTITY_TYPE is null then 'No Object' 
	when contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/page/home') then 'Lightning Homepage'
	when contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/n/') then substr(PAGE_URL,instr(PAGE_URL,'/' ,1,3)+1)
	when contains(PAGE_URL,'/lightning/o/') then substr(PAGE_URL,instr(PAGE_URL,'/' ,1,3)+1,instr(PAGE_URL,'/' ,1,4)-instr(PAGE_URL,'/' ,1,3)-1) 
	else PAGE_ENTITY_TYPE 
end

fields.name: SourceObjectType
fields.label: SourceObjectType
fields.formulaExpression:
case 
when contains(PAGE_URL,'?ws=%') then substr(PAGE_URL,instr(PAGE_URL,'%2F',1,3)+3,instr(PAGE_URL,'%2F',1,4) - (instr(PAGE_URL,'%2F',1,3)+3))
else PAGE_ENTITY_TYPE
end

fields.name: SourceRecordId
fields.label: SourceRecordId
fields.formulaExpression:
case 
when contains(PAGE_URL,'?ws=%') then substr(PAGE_URL,instr(PAGE_URL,'%2F',1,4)+3,18) else null end

fields.name: ListViewId
fields.label: ListViewId
fields.formulaExpression:
case when contains(PAGE_URL,'?filterName=') then substr(PAGE_URL, instr(PAGE_URL, '?filterName=')+12, 30)
else null
end

fields.name: TEMP_PAGE_APP_NAME
fields.label: TEMP_PAGE_APP_NAME
fields.formulaExpression:
case 
    when EVENT_TYPE = 'LightningLogger' AND (lag(EVENT_TYPE) = 'LightningPageView' OR lag(EVENT_TYPE) = 'LightningInteraction') then lag(PAGE_APP_NAME) 
    when EVENT_TYPE = 'LightningLogger' AND (lead(EVENT_TYPE) = 'LightningPageView' OR lead(EVENT_TYPE) = 'LightningInteraction') then lead(PAGE_APP_NAME) 
    else PAGE_APP_NAME 
end

fields.name: PageChangeFlag
fields.label: PageChangeFlag
fields.formulaExpression: case when current(PageName) is not null AND current(PageName) != lag(PageName) then 1 else 0 end

fields.name: PageChangeFlagDim
fields.label: PageChangeFlagDim
fields.formulaExpression: case when current(PageName) is not null AND current(PageName) != lag(PageName) then '1' else '0' end

dataset.label: BVA Lightning Page Views and Interactions Adoption
dataset.name: ${App.Datasets.BVA_LightningPageViewsAndInteractionsAdoption_tp.Name}

fields.name: ComponentName
fields.label: Component Name
fields.formulaExpression:
case 
when "CustomDataDictionary.Event_Label" != '' then "CustomDataDictionary.Event_Label"  
when EVENT_TYPE = 'LightningPageView' AND "ListView.Name" != '' then concat(PageName, ' - ', "ListView.Name")  
when EVENT_TYPE = 'LightningPageView' then PageName 
when "DataDictionary.Event_Label" != '' AND "ListView.Name" != '' then concat("ListView.Name",' - ' ,"DataDictionary.Event_Label") 
when COMPONENT_NAME != '' AND "ListView.Name" != '' then concat("ListView.Name",' - ' ,COMPONENT_NAME) 
when "DataDictionary.Event_Label" != '' then "DataDictionary.Event_Label" 
when COMPONENT_NAME != '' then COMPONENT_NAME 
when ConcatComponentEvent != '' AND "ListView.Name" != '' then concat(ConcatComponentEvent, ' - ', "ListView.Name") 
when ConcatComponentEvent != '' then ConcatComponentEvent 
else 'Unknown' 
end

FILTER0.label: FilterUserInteractions
FILTER0.description: We filter on user-driven events only, as well as general page views and Apex executions.

TRANSFORM0.label: ComputeLightningInteractions1
TRANSFORM0.description: A series of transformatinos to the LightningInteraction event logs.  Some columns are used directly in the dashboards; some are used in later compute expressions.

TRANSFORM1.label: ComputeRelativeLightningInteraction1
TRANSFORM1.description:
Compute some additional values using the multi-row (windowing) functions, based on both the Data Dictionary and previous Compute node.
No real logic to Component Name with respect to Apex classes and Page Views.

JOIN0.label: JoinDataDictionary
JOIN0.description:
Joins the LightningInteractionDataDictionary custom object entries to the event logs so as to label them better.
Since this operates on the daily delta, some entries may be historical or out-of-date.

FILTER1.label: FilterNonUserClicks
FILTER1.description: Temporarily filter out the non-user clicks events.

FILTER2.label: FilterUserClicks
FILTER2.description: Filter the user-driven click events, page views and Apex executions.

TRANSFORM2.label: ComputerleativeLightningInteraction2
TRANSFORM2.description: We compute the time taken to perform a click (Time to Action) and the time spent before another click was made (Stall Time).

APPEND0.label: JoinClicksAndNonClicks
APPEND0.description: Bring all the Lightning Interactions back together.

APPEND1.label: AppendPageViewsAndClicks
APPEND1.description: Joining the LightningPageView and LightningInteraction log types together.  This is easy, most columns will auto-match.

JOIN2.label: JoinInteractionsListViews
JOIN2.description: Add List View Names to LightningPageView logs

TRANSFORM5.label: ComputeLightningInteractions2
TRANSFORM5.description: Includes dropping ListView properties as they are embedded in ComponentName

FILTER4.label: FilterSample
FILTER4.description: Remove sample row from placeholder dataset

TRANSFORM6.label: MapLightningInteraction
TRANSFORM6.description: Generate same UI_EVENT_TYPE an UI_EVENT_SOURCE columns from MESSAGE so we can append to LightningInteraction dataset.
